top_choice_rationale: P001 credits Balasubramanian and Klenerman for sequencing by synthesis built on reversible-terminator nucleotide chemistry, fluorescent detection and surface-immobilised templates. It is mature, independently confirmed over two decades, and enabled a new capability across molecular life science. It also rests on real chemistry (molecular design, surface chemistry, reaction kinetics on immobilised molecules). The two-name allocation avoids an unverified priority judgment on Mayer, and a citation worded around the terminator chemistry keeps the exclusion of Ju and the 454 lineage coherent. P002 is a clean, mature two-name prize but a narrower extension of the framework recognised in 2010, so it ranks second, and an award is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; B017 and B048 are outside my lipid self-assembly and membrane research, and Lund colleagueship with Linke and Somfai is not a conflict
